description: Simplex developer tools. All tools are written in pure Simplex and self-compiled.

modules.name: sxc
modules.description: The Simplex compiler (sxc). Compiles .sx source files to native executables via LLVM. Supports cross-platform compilation (macOS, Linux, Windows), optimization levels, and debug information.

modules.name: sxdoc
modules.description: Documentation generator (sxdoc). Extracts doc comments and type signatures from .sx files to generate HTML documentation and JSON manifests.

modules.name: sxpm
modules.description: Package manager (sxpm). Manages dependencies, builds projects, and handles SLM model provisioning. Supports lock files, diamond dependency detection, and build caching.

modules.name: sxlsp
modules.description: Language server (sxlsp). Provides IDE features via the Language Server Protocol including completions, hover information, go-to-definition, and diagnostics.
